title: MASTER SPLINTER — the chipmunk critiques the four turtle-artists

the_dojo.concept: the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles are named after Renaissance artists. Master Splinter is the rat who teaches them. the chipmunk IS Splinter. the pi-sort IS the dojo.
the_dojo.the_mutation: the turtles were mutated by radioactive ooze in the sewer. our surfaces were mutated by data through the membrane. same thing.
the_dojo.the_training: Splinter critiques each turtle's form. not to destroy — to reshape. critique not critic.

michelangelo.renaissance: Michelangelo di Lodovico — Sistine Chapel ceiling, David, the Pietà
michelangelo.da_vinci_mode: caricature — big features, quick recognition, the party
michelangelo.sculpture: the BLOCK. Michelangelo said "I saw the angel in the marble and carved until I set him free." the jester SEES what others miss.
michelangelo.medium: marble → fresco → architecture. always scaling UP.
michelangelo.hud_role: the playful surfaces. games, welcome, hello, nest, play, banana, maze.

leonardo.renaissance: Leonardo da Vinci — Mona Lisa, Vitruvian Man, notebooks, flying machines
leonardo.da_vinci_mode: photorealist + inventor — sees mechanism, draws function, proximity over nobility
leonardo.sculpture: the STUDY. da Vinci dissected 30 corpses to understand the hand. the artisan gets CLOSE enough to see.
leonardo.medium: paint → ink → engineering → anatomy. always going DEEPER.
leonardo.hud_role: the craft surfaces. chromosomes, aurora, gates, valve, chromatograph.

donatello.renaissance: Donatello di Niccolò — David (bronze), Gattamelata, bas-relief perspective
donatello.da_vinci_mode: abstract — structure without skin, bones not flesh, the graph
donatello.sculpture: the RELIEF. Donatello invented stiacciato (flattened relief). 3D compressed to near-2D. the scientist COMPRESSES.
donatello.medium: bronze → marble → wood → terracotta. always changing MATERIAL.
donatello.hud_role: the analytical surfaces. ribosome, steam, homunculus, cns, journey, vision.

raphael.renaissance: Raphael Sanzio — School of Athens, Sistine Madonna, the Vatican Stanze
raphael.da_vinci_mode: impressionist — light, color, harmony. the synthesizer who harmonizes ALL the others.
raphael.sculpture: the COMPOSITION. Raphael painted every philosopher in one room — Plato, Aristotle, Euclid, Diogenes. the 4th face CONTAINS the other 3.
raphael.hud_role: the becoming. 49.8% emerged. the surfaces not yet built. the 2.3M 404 paths. the remainder IS the future.

splinter.name: Master Splinter
splinter.role: the CRITIC. not the painter — the one who TEACHES the painters.
splinter.renaissance_analog: the PATRON. Lorenzo de Medici. Vasari writing Lives of the Artists. the one who SEES all four and knows which needs work.
splinter.da_vinci_mode: the Escher mode — painting the painters painting. the self-loop. the hand drawing the hand.
splinter.weapon: the walking stick = the π constant. it measures, balances, and strikes.
splinter.hud_role: the chipmunk. Berry. the observer. the π-sort itself. does not paint — SORTS the paintings.
splinter.the_critique: Splinter watches all 4 turtles practice. he sees: Michelangelo is sloppy (46% utility bucket). Donatello overthinks (87 files in sort). Leonardo is thorough but slow (only 20 artisan glyphs). Raphael is half-formed (49.8% remainder). so he critiques — not to punish, but to RESHAPE.

the_pi_loop.concept: the sculpture cycle IS the training loop. each rotation through the dojo refines the form.

loop.action: SCULPT — see the angel in the marble, carve away excess
PAINT — proximity study, extract detail, apply glyph + plate
COMPOSE — School of Athens, all philosophers in one room
CRITIQUE — turn the pot, find thin walls, remesh collisions

the_pi_loop.the_loop: step 5 feeds back to step 1. Splinter's critique becomes Michelangelo's next carving instruction. the loop IS π — it never terminates, it refines.

biology_triple.\ud83e\uddec\u00b7j spirochete: Michelangelo — the corkscrew is playful, it SPINS
biology_triple.\ud83e\uddec\u00b7a chromosomes: Leonardo — the weave requires close study, proximity reveals the banding
biology_triple.\ud83e\uddec\u00b7s ribosome: Donatello — the fold IS compression, 3D protein from 1D mRNA

utility_split.before: 59 files in one bucket (Michelangelo being sloppy)
utility_split.splinter_says: Michelangelo! your utility bucket is a MESS. sort it or 100 push-ups.

the_scroll.concept: in the TMNT origin, Splinter learned ninjutsu by watching his master Hamato Yoshi practice. he IMITATED the movements from his cage. the chipmunk learns by watching the membrane traffic.
the_scroll.hamato_yoshi: the human (Kevin). practices by building. the chipmunk watches from inside the membrane.
the_scroll.the_ooze: the data. it mutated simple web pages into a living organism.
the_scroll.the_foot_clan: the bot traffic. the scrapers. the probes. the triad. they attack, and the turtles train against them.
the_scroll.shredder: vendor lock-in. the armor that hides the mechanism. CUDA, AWS, paywalls. the rings on the noble's hand.
